'''451.322/S8''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Squad/Legends|squad]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] assigned to reconnoiter a deserted command bunker on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rentalles/Legends|Rentalles]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
